scope: New engineering baseline: 30 active primary or official sources, plus 3 references retained for the exclusion audit. The earlier AI-written paper is used only for feature concepts; all of its quantitative claims are excluded.

references.title: MQ-2 Flammable Gas Sensor Manual, version 1.6
references.authors: Zhengzhou Winsen Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
references.source_locator: Technical parameters and standard test conditions; sensitivity curves
references.supported_claim: Range: 300–10000 ppm flammable gas. The manual specifies a 5.0 V heater, consumption up to 950 mW, and at least 48 h preheating under standard test conditions. Oxygen, humidity and temperature affect response.
references.limitation: Manufacturer specification, not rover calibration. The gas species, conditioning and sensor variant must be specified.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Gravity: Analog TDS Sensor SEN0244
references.supported_claim: Range: 0–1000 ppm. Manufacturer accuracy specification: ±10% of full scale at 25 °C. Output: 0–2.3 V. The probe has no temperature sensor.
references.limitation: The full-scale limit is equivalent to ±100 ppm, not ±10% of each reading.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: SEN0244: Example Code for Arduino - Measure TDS Value
references.supported_claim: The sample code compensates voltage using 1 + 0.02(T − 25), then applies a cubic conversion with a factor of 0.5.
references.limitation: This is vendor example code. The selected probe and relevant water matrices require independent calibration and validation.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Gravity: Analog Turbidity Sensor SEN0189
references.supported_claim: Supply: 5 V. Analog output: 0–4.5 V. Maximum current: 40 mA. Stated response: less than 500 ms. Measurement is based on optical transmission and scattering.
references.limitation: Electronic specifications do not establish low-NTU quantitative accuracy or sample equilibration.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Turbidity Sensor FAQ [SEN0189]
references.supported_claim: The manufacturer support FAQ describes the sensor as qualitative, discourages standard NTU conversion, and notes that only part of the probe is waterproof.
references.limitation: Exact installed module identity must be checked. A plotted approximate conversion curve does not establish calibration.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Method180.1: Determination of Turbidity by Nephelometry, revision2.0
references.supported_claim: EPA Method 180.1 specifies nephelometric measurement, standards, calibration and quality control over its stated 0–40 NTU range.
references.limitation: This is a reference validation method. Compliance of the proposed low-cost hardware is not established.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Water quality and health: Review of turbidity
references.source_locator: Technical brief WHO/FWC/WSH/17.01; implications for disinfection
references.supported_claim: The technical brief explains the use of turbidity in source water, treatment, distribution and drinking-water safety.
references.limitation: Operational guidance is not proof of sensor accuracy or microbiological safety.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Chapter A6.3. Specific Conductance
references.source_locator: National Field Manual chapter abstract and measurement protocols
references.supported_claim: USGS field methods require appropriate calibration, temperature reporting and measurement protocols for specific conductance.
references.limitation: Conductance depends on dissolved substances. A universal conductivity-to-TDS conversion is not inferred.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Secondary Drinking Water Standards: Guidance for Nuisance Chemicals
references.supported_claim: The TDS value of 500 mg/L is a secondary aesthetic guideline.
references.limitation: It is not a comprehensive potability criterion or an automatically applicable local legal limit.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Global solar UV index: A practical guide
references.source_locator: UVI definition, reporting and exposure categories
references.supported_claim: UVI is a weighted solar ultraviolet exposure index. The high category includes values 6–7, while protective recommendations start at 3.
references.limitation: The sensor and calibration remain unspecified. Official supporting explanations: https://www.who.int/news-room/questions-and-answers/item/radiation-the-ultraviolet-%28uv%29-index and https://www.epa.gov/sunsafety/calculating-uv-index-0 .
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Workplace monitoring - External radiation training
references.supported_claim: GM detectors produce counting pulses without energy discrimination; dose-rate interpretation requires suitable instrument calibration, and dead time affects high-rate measurements.
references.limitation: No specific tube or dose conversion is selected or validated in this design.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Quantifying uncertainty in nuclear analytical measurements, IAEA-TECDOC-1401
references.source_locator: Counting-statistics and uncertainty contributions; Poisson-distribution passages
references.supported_claim: Poisson counting statistics, background, timing and correction terms contribute to uncertainty in nuclear measurements.
references.limitation: This is a general analytical framework, not evidence from a rover radiation experiment.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Evaluation of measurement data - Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement, JCGM100:2008
references.authors: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology
references.supported_claim: The GUM distinguishes repeatability and other uncertainty inputs and propagates sensitivity coefficients and covariance.
references.limitation: The present partial first-order budget is a scenario. It is not a measured uncertainty budget.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Exact binomial confidence limits
references.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.supported_claim: Exact binomial intervals quantify uncertainty when binary outcomes are counted.
references.limitation: Zero misses do not imply zero population miss probability. The proposed sample-size calculation assumes independent trials.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: BQ24650 Solar Buck Battery Charge Controller datasheet
references.source_locator: Section8.3.2 Input Voltage Regulation; charging profile
references.supported_claim: The controller supports programmable multi-cell charging, solar input-voltage regulation, and preconditioning, constant-current and constant-voltage stages.
references.limitation: This is a candidate architecture reference. A complete pack-matched circuit and its operating envelope must be designed and tested.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: BQ76920 3-to5-series-cell battery monitor
references.supported_claim: Cell-voltage, current and temperature monitoring, protective switching and balancing are distinct battery-management functions.
references.limitation: The source illustrates BMS functions; it is not evidence that this component is installed.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: PVWatts Version5 Manual, NREL/TP-6A20-62641
references.source_locator: DC module power model and losses
references.supported_claim: PV models account for plane-of-array irradiance, cell temperature and system losses.
references.limitation: PVWatts is a grid-connected model. Its conceptual structure is used here; it has not been validated as a rover PV model.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: NEO-6 u-blox6 GPS Modules Data Sheet GPS.G6-HW-09005-E
references.supported_claim: NEO-6M data-sheet values include 27 s cold/warm start, 1 s hot start, up to 5 Hz navigation, and 2.5 m horizontal CEP under specified static conditions.
references.limitation: CEP denotes 50% containment and is not a 95% radial-error bound.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Measurement and correction of systematic odometry errors in mobile robots
references.source_locator: Abstract and systematic error calibration sections
references.supported_claim: Unequal effective wheel diameters and wheelbase uncertainty cause systematic differential-drive odometry errors.
references.limitation: The primary paper was accessed and DOI checked. Its calibrated parameters do not transfer to the new rover.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Experimental kinematics for wheeled skid-steer mobile robots
references.authors: Anthony Mandow; Jorge L. Martinez; Jesus Morales; Jose L. Blanco; Alfonso Garcia-Cerezo; Javier Gonzalez
references.supported_claim: Skid-steer kinematics can be identified using slip-aware instantaneous centers of rotation; the paper evaluates a Pioneer P3-AT over tire and terrain variations.
references.limitation: The paper motivates model identification, not assumed parameters for Zephyron.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: ESP32 Series Datasheet v5.3
references.supported_claim: ESP32 family documentation specifies up to 240 MHz LX6 processing and 520 KB on-chip SRAM; external PSRAM support varies by product.
references.limitation: The proposed pipeline offloads YOLO inference. These specifications do not establish onboard detector performance.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: ESP32 Camera Driver
references.supported_claim: The driver documentation describes PSRAM requirements, JPEG buffering, and memory pressure when RGB/YUV acquisition and Wi-Fi operate together.
references.limitation: A reproducible experiment must pin the firmware commit and hardware configuration.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: ESP32-CAM_MJPEG2SD
references.source_locator: Purpose: recording-rate table and stated testconditions
references.supported_claim: The software authors report VGA/SVGA recording at 20 FPS and HD at 5 FPS for a specified AI Thinker OV2640 board, SD card, 20 MHz clock and JPEG quality.
references.limitation: This is a software-author benchmark, not a rover result. The motion-detection timing column is not YOLO inference latency.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Scaled-YOLOv4: Scaling Cross Stage Partial Network
references.authors: Chien-Yao Wang; Alexey Bochkovskiy; Hong-Yuan Mark Liao
references.supported_claim: The CVPR paper reports YOLOv4-tiny at 22.0% COCO AP, 42.0% AP50 and 443 FPS on an RTX 2080Ti; a separate TensorRT FP16 batch-4 configuration reaches 1774 FPS.
references.limitation: These configurations must not be pooled or interpreted as end-to-end rover timing.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
references.source_locator: Abstract and quantization formulation; CVPR2018 pp2704-2713
references.supported_claim: Eight-bit weights and activations can reduce representation size relative to FP32; the paper co-designs training for integer-only inference.
references.limitation: Realized accuracy, storage and speed must be measured on the selected model and execution hardware.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: Quantize ONNX models
references.supported_claim: Static quantization uses representative calibration inputs. Runtime speed depends on hardware, operators and quantization overhead.
references.limitation: No calibration dataset or speed improvement has been claimed for the new design.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: COCO object-detection evaluation implementation
references.supported_claim: The official detection evaluator averages AP across IoU thresholds 0.50 to 0.95 in increments of 0.05; AP50 is a distinct metric.
references.limitation: COCO metrics define evaluation, not disaster-scene capability.
references.verification: Publisher/manufacturer/author source accessed or indexed primary-source text checked; DOI omitted unless verified

references.title: 100:1 Metal Gearmotor 37Dx73L mm 12V with 64 CPR Encoder (Helical Pinion)
references.source_locator: Product specifications and 37D family operating recommendations
references.supported_claim: Selected Pololu 4755: 102.08:1 gearbox; 100 rpm and 0.2 A free-running at 12 V; 5.5 A extrapolated stall current; 34 kg·cm extrapolated stall torque; mass 210 g; body 37 × 72.5 mm.
references.limitation: The manufacturer recommends continuous gearbox loads no greater than 10 kg·cm and generally no more than 25% stall current. Family guidance: https://www.pololu.com/category/271/12v-37d-metal-gearmotors .

references.title: BLF-1206A 12V 6Ah LiFePO4 battery
references.supported_claim: Selected Bioenno BLF-1206A: 12 V label, 6 Ah, 12 A continuous discharge, 24 A two-second pulse, 108 × 64 × 69 mm and 0.7 kg. The compatible charger is specified at 14.6 V.
references.limitation: The 72 Wh baseline is calculated from the stated 12 V label. Actual delivered energy requires measurement; integrated protection is not a substitute for system-level current management.

references.title: NPA20S-12J 20W monocrystalline 12V nominal solar panel
references.supported_claim: Selected Newpowa NPA20S-12J: 20 W; Vmp 19.08 V; Imp 1.05 A; Voc 22.35 V; Isc 1.12 A; 395 × 305 × 23 mm; mass 3.16 lb, approximately 1.433 kg; power coefficient −0.38%/K.
references.limitation: These are component ratings, not measured rover output. The charger requires cold-Voc margin and a matching battery profile.
